summary: Testing of editable tariff for 'Derecho de uso de plataforma MServer por PDV' (row #1 of COSTOS RECURRENTES - BÁSICOS) in Quote wizard. Performed a thorough code review of the diffs and a partial Playwright UI run. Login + navigation to /quotes succeeded; the 'Implementaciones' button is a dropdown trigger (not a direct opener), so wizard didn't open on first click within timeout. Code review confirms the implementation matches the spec.
action_items: Main agent: please self-test the live UI flow because the playwright run was interrupted at the wizard launch step (the 'Implementaciones' button is a Dropdown — child items 'PYME'/'CORP' are the actual openers). The underlying code changes look correct.
Consider adding a data-testid to the 'PYME'/'CORP' submenu items inside the 'Implementaciones' dropdown to make end-to-end testing more reliable.

Optional minor: the 'Otros Recurrentes' code (recurring_other_items) in the useEffect at line ~528 does NOT respect a `tarifaManual` flag (only the basic items do at line 519). Since the PRD only requires the basic row #1 to be editable, this is intentional and matches scope; just flagging for awareness.
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteWizardDialog.jsx L1757-1784: correctly renders the autoTariff branch with an editable <Input data-testid='recurring-basic-tariff-input-{index}'>. Emerald style (border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50) applied when !item.tarifaManual, amber style (border-amber-400 bg-amber-50) when item.tarifaManual=true. Unlock icon (lucide) is rendered conditionally on item.tarifaManual. Matches spec.

Quotes.jsx L1370-1387 (updateRecurringBasicItem): when field==='tarifa' and the row has autoTariff, sets next.tarifaManual = (value !== ''). This correctly handles BOTH the manual edit (value!=='' → manual=true) AND the revert path (clearing the field → manual=false). Correct.

Quotes.jsx L518-526 (auto recalc useEffect for recurring_basic_items): correctly skips items where item.tarifaManual is true (`if (!item.autoTariff || item.tarifaManual) return item;`). This protects the manual value from being overwritten when additional_items change.

Quotes.jsx L558-580 (TDD/TDC ceiling rule effect): also respects `!it.tarifaManual` when activating/deactivating the ceiling rule (lines 562, 574). Manual value is preserved across this transition. Correct.
constants.js L30: 'Derecho de uso de plataforma MServer por PDV' has autoTariff: { ceiling: 8, perUnit: 2 }. Matches PRD.
Quote total recalculation: calcularTotal(item) uses item.tarifa * cajas * bancos. Since the manual value lives in item.tarifa, the row total and Subtotal Básicos will recompute correctly. ✓
Pattern consistency: tarifaManual mirrors the existing bancosManual pattern (L1741), which is a clean, idiomatic solution.
